data.notes: November 2026 is anchored by Camp Flog Gnaw and major electronic festivals, with LA’s warehouse, queer-club, Latin, and R&B scenes filling the rest of the month.

events.title: Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival 2026
events.summary: Tyler, The Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw returns to Dodger Stadium Grounds on November 14–15, 2026. The official festival site confirms the dates, venue, all-ages policy, noon opening, and 11pm curfew.

events.title: Time Warp Los Angeles 2026
events.summary: Time Warp debuts in Los Angeles at ACE*Mission on November 27–28, 2026. The official lineup includes Richie Hawtin, Ben Klock, The Martinez Brothers, Helena Hauff b2b Juliana Huxtable, Dennis Ferrer b2b Skream, HAAi, Rødhåd, and more.

events.title: Dreamstate SoCal 2026
events.summary: Insomniac’s trance-focused Dreamstate SoCal is confirmed for November 20–21, 2026, with 2-day and single-day passes on sale. The lineup page lists Above & Beyond, ARTBAT, Astrix, Paul van Dyk, Vini Vici, Infected Mushroom, and many more.

events.title: The R&B Tour: Usher Raymond & Chris Brown
events.summary: Usher Raymond and Chris Brown bring The R&B Tour to SoFi Stadium on November 15, 2026. The venue page confirms the 7:30 PM start time and notes the show was added due to demand.

events.title: Moby Live Pasadena
events.summary: Goldenvoice’s open-air Moby Live Pasadena takes place November 7, 2026 at Brookside at the Rose Bowl. The official bill features Moby, Underworld, Fcukers, Nia Archives DJ set, and DJ Holographic on one stage with no overlapping sets.

events.title: Don Omar: The Last King World Tour
events.summary: Don Omar plays Kia Forum on November 6, 2026 as part of The Last King World Tour. The official venue page confirms the date and tour title.

events.title: SNEAK'S BIRTHDAY BEATS 2026
events.venueName: TBA - 2341 E Olympic Blvd Los Angeles, CA 90021
events.summary: Certified Groovers stages a major house gathering for DJ Sneak with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina, Doc Martin, Josh Wink, DJ Heather, John Tejada, H-Foundation, Heidi Lawden and more.

events.title: Mon Laferte: Femme Fatale Tour
events.summary: Mon Laferte’s Femme Fatale Tour is confirmed at Kia Forum on November 7, 2026. The official venue page lists the event date and tour name.

events.title: Tinashe: One Night With A Popstar
events.summary: Tinashe’s One Night With A Popstar is listed for Hollywood Palladium on November 7, 2026 at 7:00 PM. Ticketmaster confirms the Hollywood date as part of her U.S. concert listings.

events.title: OBSERVE 24 Year Anniversary // Chris Liebing [5hr Set] // Truncate // OKTAFORM
events.summary: OBSERVE celebrates 24 years of LA techno with a five-hour Chris Liebing set, Truncate and OKTAFORM visuals in a DTLA warehouse.

events.title: Rawayana: ¿Dónde es el after? World Tour
events.summary: Rawayana brings the ¿Dónde es el after? World Tour to Kia Forum on November 15, 2026. The official venue page confirms the date and tour title.

events.title: Brutalismus 3000: Harmony US Tour 2026
events.summary: Brutalismus 3000 plays Shrine Expo Hall on November 19, 2026 with Eurohead, OZA, ali rq, and deBasement. Songkick confirms the Los Angeles date, venue, lineup, and 8 PM doors.

events.title: PERREOLAND | Los Angeles ft. Jowell y Randy
events.summary: Touring reggaeton party brand PERREOLAND lands at The Mayan with Jowell y Randy for an old-school-vs-new-school reggaeton night.

events.title: Bitch Planet: Barbazon presents Big Freedia
events.summary: Rhonda INTL, SQUISH, and Bitch Planet present Big Freedia live at Don Quixote on November 6, 2026. The RA listing confirms Big Freedia, UNiiQU3, Star Amerasu, and Cquestt on the lineup.

events.title: Rhondavous: The Ravesgiving
events.summary: Rhonda INTL’s Thanksgiving Eve party Rhondavous: The Ravesgiving takes over Catch One on November 25, 2026. The RA listing describes five rooms of club concepts running from 6 PM to 4 AM.

events.title: Insomniac presents Valentino Khan
events.summary: Insomniac presents Valentino Khan at Hollywood Palladium on November 14, 2026. The official Insomniac page confirms the Los Angeles date and venue.

events.title: CLOSER presents THERMAL with 6 SENSE
events.summary: CLOSER brings Australian duo 6 SENSE to Los Angeles for their LA debut on November 6, 2026. The confirmed RA lineup also includes fun2bjane, S.I.M, Brick, and Dune.

events.title: Lights Down Low feat. yaego
events.summary: LA party institution Lights Down Low presents yaego on November 7, 2026 at a downtown location disclosed to ticket buyers. The RA listing confirms the 11 PM–4 AM timing and 21+ admission.

events.title: Bad Gyal - Más Cara World Tour 2026
events.summary: Bad Gyal brings the Más Cara World Tour to The Wiltern on Friday, November 6, 2026. The confirmed Los Angeles date is part of her U.S. run for the tour.

events.title: Three Days Grace - Alienation Tour
events.summary: Three Days Grace closes the U.S. leg of the Alienation Tour at Intuit Dome in nearby Inglewood on Sunday, November 22, 2026. Live Nation lists I Prevail and The Funeral Portrait on the bill.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti - Una Historia Importante
events.summary: Italian pop star Eros Ramazzotti performs at YouTube Theater in nearby Inglewood on Saturday, November 7, 2026. Live Nation confirms the Una Historia Importante date at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Sabaton: Legends on Tour
events.summary: Swedish metal band Sabaton brings Legends on Tour to Hollywood Palladium on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Live Nation lists Pop Evil and Wings of Steel on the lineup.

events.title: The Damned - Final Damnation 50
events.summary: Punk pioneers The Damned bring their Final Damnation 50 show to The Wiltern on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Ticketmaster lists Flamin' Groovies and The Courettes as support.

events.title: L7: The Last Hurrah Tour 2026
events.summary: LA-founded alternative rock band L7 plays The Wiltern on Saturday, November 14, 2026 as part of The Last Hurrah Tour 2026. Live Nation confirms the date and venue.

events.title: NeoBounce Presents: Ueberrest (LA Debut)
events.summary: NeoBounce brings German hard-techno/bounce act Ueberrest to Los Angeles for a late-night secret-location debut with Casska, Khrome, and NoWhere Inc. supporting.

events.title: Marilyn Manson: Live in Los Angeles
events.summary: Marilyn Manson headlines The Wiltern on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The Ticketmaster listing confirms the Los Angeles venue and 7:00 PM event time.

events.title: Ólafur Arnalds
events.summary: Icelandic composer and electronic/classical artist Ólafur Arnalds performs at The Wiltern on Friday, November 13, 2026. The Ticketmaster listing confirms the date, venue, and 7:00 PM time.

events.title: Fear Factory Performing Demanufacture in Its Entirety
events.summary: Industrial-metal band Fear Factory performs Demanufacture in full at Whisky A Go Go on Saturday, November 28, 2026. The venue calendar lists Darkest Hour, Brotality, Stepa, and Of The Betrayer on the bill.

events.title: PJ Morton – Saturday Night Sunday Morning Tour
events.summary: Goldenvoice-presented Los Angeles stop for PJ Morton’s Saturday Night Sunday Morning Tour, a non-arena R&B/soul date at The United Theater on Broadway.

events.title: The Limiñanas
events.summary: French psych-garage act The Limiñanas play Teragram Ballroom on Monday, November 2, 2026. Ticketmaster lists Native Sun in the event lineup.

events.title: The Untouchables
events.summary: Los Angeles ska/mod veterans The Untouchables play Whisky A Go Go in West Hollywood on Friday, November 27, 2026. The venue’s official calendar confirms the all-ages show and 6:00 PM doors.

events.title: Obscene (Goth / Industrial / EBM / Darkwave)
events.summary: Los Angeles Industrial’s monthly DTLA dark-music night, with residents Industria Nova and Damascus Knives playing EBM and industrial all night with vendors.

events.title: R&B Wednesdays at Mama Shelter
events.summary: Recurring Hollywood R&B showcase associated with Bongo ByTheWay and Sterling Simms, pairing live-band R&B performances with DJ-led rooftop nightlife at Mama Shelter.

events.title: HYPER-MUSE
events.summary: Horror Hi-Fi’s free RA-ticketed electronica club night at a TBA Los Angeles location, listed for a 10 PM–2 AM run with lineup still to be announced.
